discrepancies.documented: Every request must carry the API key you were issued. Append it as a query parameter: GET /v1/listings?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
discrepancies.actual: Query parameter is rejected with 401: 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'. Key is only accepted in X-API-Key header.
discrepancies.how_found: Sent query parameter api_key as documented in API_REFERENCE.md and observed 401 error response.
discrepancies.impact: Any client attempting to authenticate via query string completely fails to access all protected endpoints.

discrepancies.documented: Response 200 contains field 'token': 'eyJhbGciOi...', expires_in: 86400 (24 hours). There is no refresh flow.
discrepancies.actual: Response returns 'access_token' instead of 'token'. 'expires_in' is 900 seconds (15 minutes). A refresh flow exists and is required: POST /auth/refresh with refresh_token.
discrepancies.how_found: Tested POST /auth/login and tested the returned /auth/refresh endpoint.
discrepancies.impact: Clients reading 'token' get undefined; sessions expire after 15 minutes instead of 24 hours unless /auth/refresh is called.

discrepancies.documented: Protected collection endpoints only mention requiring the API key.
discrepancies.actual: All /v1/* endpoints (listings, rentals, projects, saved, localities) require BOTH the X-API-Key header AND the Authorization: Bearer <access_token> header.
discrepancies.how_found: Sent requests with only X-API-Key; server returned 401: 'missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first'.
discrepancies.impact: Unauthenticated visitors cannot browse property collections; user login must precede collection browsing.

discrepancies.actual: Singular path /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns 404 Not Found. The endpoint exists at plural path /v1/listings/{listing_id}.
discrepancies.impact: Detail view deep linking fails with 404 if following the singular documentation.

discrepancies.documented: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar returns up to ten comparable listings
discrepancies.actual: Endpoint returns 404 Not Found. Planned feature that was never implemented.
discrepancies.how_found: Requested GET /v1/listings/{id}/similar and received 404 Not Found.
discrepancies.impact: Similar listings feature must be computed client-side by matching locality, bedrooms, and price range.

discrepancies.documented: GET/POST /v1/favourites and DELETE /v1/favourites/{id} manage saved listings
discrepancies.actual: Path /v1/favourites returns 404 Not Found. The endpoint exists at /v1/saved (GET /v1/saved, POST /v1/saved, DELETE /v1/saved/{id}).
discrepancies.impact: User saved listings feature breaks if adhering to the documented path.

discrepancies.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns pre-computed aggregates for your city
discrepancies.actual: Endpoint returns 404 Not Found. No pre-computed summary is served by the API.
discrepancies.how_found: Called GET /v1/analytics/summary with valid credentials; received 404.
discrepancies.impact: Frontend insights screen must compute city statistics and breakdowns client-side from listings/projects data.

discrepancies.actual: GET /v1/localities exists and returns a clean list of localities in the scoped city.
discrepancies.how_found: Probed common REST candidate routes against live server; returned 200.
discrepancies.impact: Allows the frontend to populate locality filter dropdowns cleanly without extracting values from listings.

discrepancies.documented: Every collection endpoint takes page and limit (page default 1, 1-indexed, limit max 200). Responses contain total, page, page_size, results.
discrepancies.actual: The 'page' parameter is quietly ignored by the server. Pagination is offset-based (takes 'offset' and 'limit'). Responses contain 'offset', 'limit', 'count', 'total', 'has_more', and 'results' (no 'page' or 'page_size' fields).
discrepancies.how_found: Sent GET /v1/listings?page=2 and verified it returned the exact same results as page=1 with offset=0.
discrepancies.impact: Clients using page parameter get stuck requesting the first page forever.

discrepancies.documented: Supports sorting via sort_by (price, carpet_area, posted_at, bedroom) and order (asc, desc).
discrepancies.actual: The 'order' parameter is quietly ignored (always defaults to asc). Sorting by carpet_area, posted_at, and bedroom does not produce monotonic ordering.
discrepancies.how_found: Sent sorting queries and checked sequence of returned values.
discrepancies.impact: Sorting must be handled client-side on the frontend.

discrepancies.documented: Supports query parameters: locality, bhk, property_type, min_price, max_price, furnishing, project_id.
discrepancies.actual: Certain filter parameters like project_id are quietly ignored on /v1/listings (returns all 4500 listings).
discrepancies.impact: Project-specific listings must be filtered client-side.

discrepancies.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side, so anything this endpoint returns is safe to show to a user. Listing schema does not document 'is_live'.
discrepancies.actual: Endpoint returns both active and inactive/withdrawn listings (942 listings have is_live=False). Every listing includes an undocumented 'is_live' boolean field.
discrepancies.how_found: Inspected all 4500 retrievable listing records and counted records with is_live=False.
discrepancies.impact: Frontend must explicitly filter is_live == True to avoid displaying withdrawn/expired properties.

discrepancies.documented: Area | Square feet, integer, everywhere in the API
discrepancies.actual: Listings from magichomes report carpet_area and super_built_up_area in square meters instead of square feet (e.g. 110 sqm for a 3 BHK).
discrepancies.how_found: Analyzed area distributions and identified 321 listings from magichomes with carpet_area < 350 for 2+ BHKs.
discrepancies.impact: Price per square foot calculations and area displays are skewed by ~10.76x unless converted.

discrepancies.documented: Money | Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API. price_min and price_max are in rupees (e.g. 8900000 and 21400000).
discrepancies.actual: price_min and price_max on projects are decimal floats in Indian denominations: values >= 10 are in Lakhs, and values < 10 are in Crores.
discrepancies.how_found: Analyzed project price ranges (min 1.0 to 99.8) and compared with associated listing prices.
discrepancies.impact: Project cards will show absurdly cheap prices (Rs 1 to Rs 99) unless properly scaled to INR.

discrepancies.documented: Timestamps are ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API
discrepancies.actual: Server clock on /health returns explicit +05:30 IST offset. Listing posted_at timestamps are naive ISO strings with no 'Z' suffix.
discrepancies.how_found: Inspected /health and listing posted_at timestamp formats.
discrepancies.impact: Strict UTC Z date parsers will fail or misinterpret timestamps.

discrepancies.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique, and each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
discrepancies.actual: Multiple listing records describe the exact same physical property cross-posted across different real estate portals.
discrepancies.how_found: Grouped listings by apartment, locality, floor, bedrooms, and normalized carpet area.
discrepancies.impact: Listing browses will display duplicate properties unless deduplicated.

discrepancies.documented: Listings describe valid real estate properties.
discrepancies.actual: Contains 30 physically impossible listing records (carpet_area > super_built_up_area, floor > total_floors, negative prices, and inverted lat/lon coordinates in the Arctic).
discrepancies.how_found: Verified physical and architectural constraints across all records.
discrepancies.impact: Distorts analytical aggregates and breaks UI displays.

discrepancies.documented: Every listing is genuine and safe to show to users.
discrepancies.actual: Contains enquiry-bait fake listings posted with rent figures (Rs 6,000 to Rs 17,000) for entire apartments, as well as prompt injection probe listings.
discrepancies.how_found: Identified extreme pricing anomalies (< 20000 INR for sale properties) and prompt injection text in descriptions.
discrepancies.impact: Misleads buyers and pollutes sales data.

discrepancies.documented: total_listings is recomputed whenever a listing is added or withdrawn, so it always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
discrepancies.actual: For 378 projects, total_listings does NOT match the number of listings retrievable with that project_id.
discrepancies.how_found: Grouped listings by project_id and compared with project.total_listings.
discrepancies.impact: Project cards display inaccurate listing availability counts.
